_note: One dictionary, two registers. hi-Latn is the default app voice (Hinglish, Latin script). en is the toggle. The bill/PDF never uses this file's hi-Latn strings: invoices are always formal English (see invoice.*). {placeholders} are filled at runtime.

remind.msg.warm.hi-Latn:
Namaste {contact} ji 🙏 {business} ke bill no. {number} ({amount}, {date}) ka payment abhi baaki hai. Jab suvidha ho, UPI se bhej dijiye: {upi}. Bill saath mein laga hai.

Hello {contact}, a gentle reminder that payment for bill {number} ({amount}, {date}) is pending. Please pay by UPI when convenient: {upi}. The bill is attached.

— {business}

Hello {contact}. Payment for bill {number} ({amount}, {date}) has been due for {days} days. Please pay by UPI this week: {upi}. The bill is attached.
— {business}

remind.msg.second.hi-Latn:
{contact} ji, ek baar phir yaad dila raha hoon: {number} ({amount}, {date}) abhi tak baaki hai. Koi dikkat ho toh bata dijiye. UPI: {upi}. Bill phir se saath mein hai.
Dhanyavaad. — {business}
remind.msg.second.en:
{contact}, following up once more: {number} ({amount}, {date}) is still unpaid. Let me know if there's any issue. UPI: {upi}. Bill attached again.
Thank you. — {business}

assess.unsupported-sez.do.hi-Latn: Draft saved hai. Yeh ek bill apne CA se banwao.
assess.unsupported-sez.do.en: Your draft is saved. Ask your accountant to raise this one.

assess.unsupported-deemed-export.do.en: Your draft is saved. Ask your accountant to raise this one.

assess.unsupported-reverse-charge.do.en: Your draft is saved. Ask your accountant, or remove the marking.

assess.unsupported-advance-receipt.hi-Latn: Yeh advance ki receipt hai. Yeh app abhi advance receipt nahi banata.
assess.unsupported-advance-receipt.en: This is an advance receipt. This app cannot issue that yet.

assess.unsupported-advance-receipt.do.hi-Latn: Draft saved hai. Kaam hone par bill banao, ya CA se receipt banwao.
assess.unsupported-advance-receipt.do.en: Your draft is saved. Bill when the work is done, or ask your accountant for the receipt.

assess.unsupported-non-gst-supply.hi-Latn: Yeh non-GST cheez hai (jaise petrol). Yeh app abhi aisa bill nahi banata.
assess.unsupported-non-gst-supply.en: This is a non-GST supply (like petrol). This app cannot issue that yet.

assess.unsupported-non-gst-supply.do.hi-Latn: Draft saved hai. Yeh ek bill apne CA se banwao.
assess.unsupported-non-gst-supply.do.en: Your draft is saved. Ask your accountant to raise this one.

assess.gst-status-unconfirmed.do.hi-Latn: Aap mein jaake GST status chuno. Pata na ho to CA ek minute mein bata dega.
assess.gst-status-unconfirmed.do.en: Open Aap and choose your GST status. Your accountant can tell you in a minute.

assess.composition-tax.en: Under composition you cannot collect GST on a bill.

assess.composition-tax.do.hi-Latn: Har line ka GST hata do; bill of supply banega.
assess.composition-tax.do.en: Remove GST from every line; a bill of supply goes out.

assess.composition-legend.hi-Latn: Bill par likha jayega: "composition taxable person, not eligible to collect tax on supplies".
assess.composition-legend.en: The bill will carry: "composition taxable person, not eligible to collect tax on supplies".

assess.unregistered-no-gst.en: You are not registered for GST, so no GST is added to this bill.

assess.gst-off-plain-invoice.en: You switched GST off on this bill: it goes out as a plain invoice.

assess.missing-gstin.en: Your GSTIN is needed on a GST bill.

assess.missing-seller-state.hi-Latn: Sahi GST ke liye aapki dukaan ka State chahiye.
assess.missing-seller-state.en: Your business state is needed to work out the right GST.

assess.missing-place-of-supply.hi-Latn: Yeh supply kis State ke liye hai, batao.
assess.missing-place-of-supply.en: Please confirm which state this supply is for.

assess.missing-place-of-supply.do.hi-Latn: Bill mein customer ka State chuno.

assess.rate-not-chosen.do.en: Choose the rate for each item. If one really is nil-rated, choose 0% so the bill says you meant it.

assess.nil-rated-on-tax-invoice.en: Every line is nil-rated: such a bill is a bill of supply. Switch GST off for this bill.

assess.self-billing.hi-Latn: Customer ka GSTIN aapka hi hai.
assess.self-billing.en: The customer's GSTIN is your own.

assess.hsn-too-short.hi-Latn: {n} item ka HSN code chhota hai: kam se kam {digits} digit chahiye.

assess.hsn-too-short.do.hi-Latn: Item mein poora HSN/SAC code daalo.
assess.hsn-too-short.do.en: Enter the full HSN/SAC code on the item.

assess.b2c-recipient-details.do.hi-Latn: Customer mein pata aur State daalo.
